subject: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owner checklist (VPC, SSO, IP allowlists, KMS)
content:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantivahealth.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@quantivahealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owner checklist (VPC, SSO, IP allowlists, KMS)

Hi Maya / Ethan —

Thanks again for the call today. Below is a concise readout and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone for the POC environment setup so we can align owners and target dates. I captured the items your SecOps team flagged as blockers.

POC ENVIRONMENT - KEY DEPENDENCIES (what we need to unblock testing)
- VPC peering / private network access
  - Owner: Quantiva NetOps (Ethan) to request peering and provide CIDR ranges.
  - Redwood ask: target peer setup + route table entries; we will provide connector IPs.
- Inbound IP allowlist (control plane / data egress)
  - Owner: Quantiva SecOps (Maya) to add Redwood control-plane IPs (we listed in the sheet).
  - Redwood ask: confirm expected egress flows (S3, telemetry endpoints).
- SSO / SAML integration (for testers & admin access)
  - Owner: Quantiva Identity team (Maya) to provide SAML metadata / IdP cert.
  - Redwood will provide SP metadata and test account provisioning steps.
- Secrets & KMS footprint (customer-managed CMK vs Redwood-managed)
  - Owner: Quantiva Security (Maya + Ethan) to decide if CMK required.
  - Redwood options: use customer KMS (bring-your-own) or Redwood KMS with audit logs; list of supported providers included.

Proposed MAP milestone (POC readiness):
- Target date: 2026-09-24 (3 weeks) — aims to have network + identity + secrets choices in place so we can schedule an environment handoff and smoke test.
- Success criteria: VPC peering established, allowlist verified, SSO test account works, secrets access validated by Redwood during smoke test.

Immediate next steps (action owners & due dates)
1) Ethan: share CIDR block(s) and preferred peering window by 2026-09-09. (Action: Ethan)
2) Maya: send SAML metadata/XML and confirm whether Quantiva will manage CMKs by 2026-09-10. (Action: Maya)
3) Naomi (Redwood SE): attach initial network diagram and SP metadata; will provide step-by-step peering instructions and IP list by EOD 2026-09-07. (Action: Naomi)
4) Alex: update MAP spreadsheet and HubSpot milestone (I updated the drive folder link below).

Attachments: map-poc-env-deps.xlsx (milestones & owner cells), redwood-sso-metadata.xml (SP metadata), quantiva-network-diagram.pdf (placeholder for your NetOps).

If the proposed dates don't work, tell me what window you prefer and we'll adjust the MAP. Happy to run a quick 20-min NetOps + IdP alignment call this week if helpful.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantivahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@quantivahealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owner checklist (VPC, SSO, IP allowlists, KMS)

Thanks Alex — helpful summary. A few clarifying notes from our side after reviewing the XLS: 

- Peering: we can provision the peering but need a 2-hour maintenance window (preferred after 18:00 PT) because of route propagation testing. Can Redwood accommodate a post-18:00 test window?
- IP allowlist: will confirm the outbound destinations (S3 buckets + telemetry) by 2026-09-10; we may need to whitelist a /28 range rather than individual IPs for load balancer headroom.
- SSO: we'll share SAML metadata. Question: does Redwood require signed assertions or just signed metadata? Our IdP team prefers unsigned assertions for now.
- KMS: Quantiva prefers using a customer-managed CMK for audit alignment; we need Redwood's KMS integration docs and any additional attestation.

I'll sync with NetOps and IdP tomorrow and push the items to you by Friday EOD. If Naomi can sketch the peering steps for our NetOps engineer, that will speed things up.

Best,
Maya
Director, Security & Identity | Quantiva Health
---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantivahealth.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@quantivahealth.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 13:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owner checklist (VPC, SSO, IP allowlists, KMS)

Hi Maya / Ethan —

Quick responses inline to be prescriptive for your NetOps and IdP teams: 

- Peering window: post-18:00 PT is fine; we can be available 18:30–20:30 PT on 2026-09-10 if that matches your schedule. We'll do route verification and a brief tokenized request replay to verify connectivity.
- IP allowlist: allowing a /28 is acceptable; please confirm the final CIDR and we will adjust our connector NAT configuration.
- SAML assertions: Redwood's SP accepts unsigned assertions for initial test accounts, but for production you should plan for signed assertions. We'll perform an SP-initiated test first. Attached: redwood-sso-metadata.xml and a short SSO checklist.
- KMS/CMK: we support both customer-managed keys (AWS KMS CMK) and Redwood-managed keys. For CMK flow we need: key ARN, kms:Decrypt permissions for the environment execution role, and an IAM role we can assume (sts:AssumeRole) for secret rotation checks. I'll attach an example IAM policy snippet in the Drive link.

I've attached a simple network diagram (quantiva-network-diagram.pdf) that shows where peering sits relative to our connector. Also attached the updated MAP spreadsheet (map-poc-env-deps.xlsx) with owner cells and the dates you proposed.

Proposed meeting: Naomi + Ethan + Quantiva NetOps on 2026-09-10 18:30 PT — confirm if that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: quantiva-network-diagram.pdf (diagram), redwood-sso-metadata.xml (SP metadata), map-poc-env-deps.xlsx (milestones)
---
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@quantivahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantivahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owner checklist (VPC, SSO, IP allowlists, KMS)

All good — 2026-09-10 18:30 PT works for NetOps. We'll share the /28 CIDR and IdP metadata during that meeting. Regarding CMK: will confirm the key ARN before the meeting; we prefer to provision the CMK ahead of time so Redwood can validate permissions during the session.

I'll accept the calendar invite when Naomi sends it. Thanks everyone for the clear runbook.

—Ethan
Ethan Cole
Senior Network Engineer | Quantiva Health
